name: Prone Straight Leg Raise
steps: Lie face down (prone) on a mat with your legs extended straight and your forehead resting on your folded hands.
Tighten your abdominal muscles slightly to brace your lower back and keep your pelvis anchored to the floor.
Squeeze your glute on the target side and lift your entire straight leg roughly 4 to 6 inches off the floor.
Ensure your knee remains locked straight and your hip bone stays in contact with the mat.
Hold for 2 seconds at the peak of the lift, focusing on glute contraction.
Slowly lower your leg back down to the floor under control.
coaching_cues: Do not arch your lower back or twist your hips to lift the leg higher; motion should come purely from the glute.
Keep your toes pointed down toward the floor.
Maintain steady abdominal bracing to protect your lumbar spine.
